import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a scatter plot of Sleep Duration vs Physical Activity Level
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Physical Activity Level', data=sleep_health, hue='BMI Category', palette='viridis')
plt.title('Relationship Between Sleep Duration and Physical Activity Level')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Physical Activity Level')
plt.legend(title='BMI Category')
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of Quality of Sleep vs Age
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Age', y='Quality of Sleep', data=sleep_health, hue='Gender', palette='viridis')
plt.title('Relationship Between Quality of Sleep and Age')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram of Daily Steps
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.histplot(sleep_health['Daily Steps'], kde=True, bins=10)
plt.title('Distribution of Daily Steps')
plt.xlabel('Daily Steps')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
